newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 21.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
Police are questioning two suspected armed robbers following an incident last week in which passengers were robbed on a South London commuter train.
'COME CLEAN' CALL ON WINDFALL TAX GROWS

The Labour Party is being asked by Welsh water and electricity group Hyder to explain details behind its "windfall tax" proposals. Earlier this month the chief executive of Eastern Group said that any tax would be challenged in the courts.
The board of Discovery has dismissed a bid by Premier Oil as too low. The move is a blow for Premier who planned to expand in Indonesia.
CRIME ON INCREASE AMONG HK BROKERS

Daniel Lai, a leading member of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, has been arrested by the Commercial Crime Bureau on charges of stealing 1m pounds stg in clients' securities. His arrest highlights a growing problem facing many small and medium sized local brokers as their traditional client base diminishes. -- For a full range of news monitoring services, phone BMC on +44 71 377 1742
